note: THE FRINGE FAMILIES (principal 2026-10-10; statuses per the principal's ruling of 2026-10-13: no source is banned as a category, only METHODS are). Ten information families placed explicitly in the universe: a family id, named public/licensed candidate sources, an MT5 economic mapping (instruments + channel) and a conversion stage that research/breadth_frontier.py DERIVES every hour from the tree. Every source carries `terms_read` (READ, with the verbatim clause quoted and the date it was read via WebFetch, or UNREAD) and `access_status`: API_PERMITTED (an official API or free tier, used within its published limits), NEEDS_KEY (the same, waiting on a key the box holds as an env var), PUBLIC_PAGE (a public page we are permitted to fetch), IDEAS_ONLY (read for ideas, never fetched as live input -- every UNREAD source is here) or METHOD_BLOCKED (reaching it would need bypassing a login, paywall, CAPTCHA, rate limit or region lock; the reason is named). Idea provenance never blocks a cell.
terms_rule: API_PERMITTED / NEEDS_KEY / PUBLIC_PAGE require a READ terms page with a verbatim quote; an UNREAD source is IDEAS_ONLY and never fetched as live input; METHOD_BLOCKED names the method that would be needed.

families.name: Hyperspectral, radar (SAR), RF, acoustic and seismic sensing

mt5_mapping.channel: a seismic event or SAR-visible disruption at a mine, port, refinery or LNG train is a supply shock: metals and energy reprice first, then the exporter's currency (AUD, CAD, JPY after domestic quakes) and the exposed index; hyperspectral crop vigour leads the softs.
